purpose_context: Attendees of the upcoming Spec Kitty training need a short self-paced prep before the session: the basic vocabulary (agent, skill, doctrine, chatbot vs agentic) and a working setup of Git, Python 3.11+ and an AI coding agent, tailored by a short intake to their OS, hardware and tool. It is a standalone static site hosted on the trainer's GitHub Pages, so the live session can spend its time on spec-driven building instead of installs.
purpose_tldr: A light, standalone pre-session e-learning so Spec Kitty class attendees arrive knowing the key terms and with Git, Python and an AI coding agent installed.
source_description: Light, standalone pre-session e-learning for the Spec Kitty class: intake-tailored setup for any OS, hardware and AI coding tool, per-attendee isolated, hosted on GitHub Pages.
